item.title: David Licauco finishes strong at Hyrox debut
item.description: Pambansang Ginoo David Licauco recently made his debut in indoor fitness competition Hyrox. Hyrox combines running with several functional exercises such as rowing, skiergs, burpees, and the like. The sport is quickly gaining popularity worldwide among athletes and fitness enthusiasts. David participated for the first time in the Taipei, Taiwan, leg of Hyrox held on March 1. Check out David Licauco's Hyrox debut in this gallery.
